title: Seneye Water-Change Recovery Time
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=seneye:reading
| search recovery_sec=*
| stats avg(recovery_sec) as avg_recovery_sec perc90(recovery_sec) as p90_recovery_sec count as samples by tank_name
| sort 0 - avg_recovery_sec
description: Measures water-change recovery time by tank.
value: Recovery time after a water change shows how quickly the system settles back into its normal range.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for water-change recovery time to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 water-change recovery time.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how long water-change recovery time usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
